items.heading: Data Engineering Is a Real,
items.text: Data Engineering Is a Real, Data engineering is a real, growing field in India, built on genuine demand rather than hype.

items.heading: "Data" Careers Get Lumped Together
items.text: "Data" careers get lumped together under one umbrella term, and picking the wrong lane under that umbrella is a common, expensive mistake that only shows up after the first few months on the job. Data engineer leads this comparison on purpose, not by convention: of the three, it carries the strongest real growth and growth headroom, for the reasons the sections above and below lay out in detail, a thinner entry-level queue, pay close to the top of the data-career stack, and a clear path from execution to platform ownership.

The realistic floor without proof. Services and IT-consulting firms hire here on SQL basics and a general engineering degree, with limited fast-track growth unless a real project gets built on the side.
Fresher, top institute into a product company or GCC
Rs 14-20 LPA, some offers Rs 20-28 LPA
Reserved for a smaller slice of graduates combining a strong CS foundation with a genuine, explainable systems project, GCC and product-company data platform teams filter hard on this.
Mid-level, 3-5 years, services or analytics firm
A steady but slower-compounding track unless a services-to-product switch or a specialisation happens on top of it.

items.heading: The Demo, the Dashboard,
items.text: The demo, the dashboard, and the model prediction get the applause. The pipeline that cleaned, moved, and made that data trustworthy in the first place gets mentioned only when it breaks.

items.heading: Career
items.text: Career-day talks, LinkedIn posts, and coaching-institute ads are full of "become a data scientist" pitches. Almost none of them mention that a data scientist cannot run a single model without a data engineer's pipeline feeding it clean, current data.

items.heading: Job Descriptions for Data Engineers
items.text: Job descriptions for data engineers increasingly bundle in distributed systems, cloud cost management, governance, and AI-pipeline support, a wider skill combination than most other entry points into the data field.
